rationale: Build on the 9x512 recurrent-tail QK best by tying only the two recurrent tail blocks' Q/K matrices. The local winner already says those Q/K tensors are the protected critical path, while broader tail sharing hurt. This averages the tail Q/K weights at init and sums their gradients thereafter, preserving compile stability and the existing quant-aware int8 endgame while spending the sharing budget only on the float-kept tensors most likely to move final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact.
title: Recurrent-Tail QK Weight Tying
